title: Bidirectional dependency proof: packages/permission/** is a downstream generic capability with zero Team coupling

method.forward_scan: Every import/export-from/dynamic-import/require specifier was extracted (regex over full file text, line numbers from match offset) from the 28 source files under packages/permission/** (extensions .ts/.tsx/.js/.jsx/.mjs/.cjs/.mts/.cts) in the legacy checkout, then classified: local relative | workspace package (sub-classified: team = packages/team/**, upstream_core = package dir exists at upstream SHA cd5ef814 via git cat-file -e, fork_only = absent, vendored = vendor/**, permission_intra = within the three permission packages) | external npm.
method.reverse_scan: The same specifier extraction ran over every source file of the legacy checkout outside packages/permission/** (284 workspace packages enumerated from all package.json files) to find references to the three permission package names.
